passerby.emotions: Female, 42 year old, down to earth, precise, cool-headed but tension can be heard in her voice

dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
This is Anna Stark from the 'Silence Evening' care facility.
{ADDRESS?} What's the address ma'am?
It's [[ADDRESS]]
It's 53 Wolden Street
It's 4 Pine Street
It's 110 Cedar Avenue
{WHAT HAPPENED?} Tell me what happened?
We still don't have electricity after the earthquake.
{IT'S NORMAL} Ma'am, there are a lot of households that don't have electricity right now.
But we have elderly guests to take care of!
{AREN'T YOU PREPARED?} Aren't you prepared for such situations?
One of our emergency generators broke during earthquake, we cannot sustain for much longer.
{NO SPARE ONE?} Don't you have a spare generator?
You think I am an idiot?! If the situation wasn't critical and we had other options I wouldn't be calling out, especially after an earthquake. I know you are completely busy.
{ANY DANGER?} OK. Is anyone in a life-threatening situation?
One of our patients has an artificial heart, and his batteries are running out!
{TRY RECHARGING IT} Is it possible to recharge the battery?
Internal battery is empty and external one is almost depleted.
{WHAT DO YOU SUGGEST?} What do you suggest?
Send us someone with a power generator and if that ain't gonna happen he needs to be taken to a hospital fast! I mean fast!
{OWN TRANSPORT?}You have your own transport?
If I had, I wouldn't be calling you. Patient is nonambulatory, an ambulance is a necessity.
{HOW MUCH TIME LEFT?}How much time do we have?
A few minutes, less than that if you want to transport him in a vehicle without onboard life-support.
{I'LL SEND A TECH UNIT} I'll try to request someone with battery units or a fully-fitted ambulance as soon as possible.
Hurry or he'll die.
{TEAM'S ON THE WAY} Don't you worry, ma'am. The team is on their way.
{CALM DOWN}Ma'am please calm down.
Do something or my patient's gonna die!
Hello, are you there?

reportElement.texten: A facility for the elderly didn't have electricity after a quake and theirs emergency generator had broken.
The operator decided to send emergency services.
The caller has lost her patience, because of operator's questions.
The emergency services have managed to run power generator again.
The battery has exhausted, causing the person heart to stop.
